symmetric-write.obstruction: degenerate critical mode: 2 directions become critical together at the write point; the critical eigenspace is 2-dimensional, so the drift reduced to one critical line, a pitchfork of one component, does not describe the write

threshold-write.class: C R(degenerate critical mode) W R(fold) K L

phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of beta in [0.5, 2.5] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: degenerate critical mode: 2 directions become critical together; the critical eigenspace is 2-dimensional, not a line

law.obstruction_in_nonlinear_stage: the law differs from the full dynamics by up to 0.024 (4.3 errors): the choice is not complete at the end of the linear stage (noise during the nonlinear stage, or a further mode brought into play), and the written states retain it (0 % change state during a hold of 56.6 time units)
